notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259457/517bca6dc422fc92f103f13fd1ec82d68ffc9b86.jpg[/img]
In version 1.2 we changed:
[list]
[*] controlls - now you crouch with down direction, and you can "catch" ladders/chains by pressing jump button when you are on them,
[*] start lifes from 4 to 12,
[*] spikes, we added skull which indicate when spikes will come out,
[*] music track in blue zone,
[*] minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39259457/6e09cc467aeff0bc6395ae06007f000c20858b03.jpg[/img]

In version 1.1 we changed and fixed some things like:
[list]
[*] new checkpoint system, you need to reach golden candlestick to activate checkpoint,
[*] added ability to change the setting of the keyboard controls,
[*] every 10 000 points player gains one extra life,
[*] for every family member rescued player gains extra life,
[*] we fixed problem where picked-up hearts were spawning after game reload,
[*] the game design has been changed in several places to lower the difficulty level,
[*] minor bug fixes.
[/list]
